result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall: carousel clipping and the partially visible bottom card are expected scroll behaviors and excluded. The main defect found is a typo in the search bar placeholder text.

issues.description: Typo in the search input placeholder text: 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' should read 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to read 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The category filter chips use inconsistent capitalization — 'All' is capitalized while the other chips like 'Pizza', 'Sushi' also use title case, but compared to the sentence-case headings elsewhere this mixes casing conventions.
issues.suggestion: Use lowercase category names (e.g., 'All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi') for consistent sentence-style formatting.
